Raw HTML to browser-engine PDF conversion
Native path，Base64，and chunked PDF ingestion
Same-origin editor preview iframe and enhancer lifecycle
Renderer-preserved Markdown HTML and generated HTML
Filesystem-backed file and resource search
Interactive host screen capture
Static site source scan，render，stage，and publish

capabilities.description: Capture pixels from the host display
Set process environment variables or executable search path
Emit or consume application runtime events
Start an external executable with application authority
Enter native parser，model，or device code in-process
Write diagnostic or user-controlled data to logs
Replace a checked path or ancestor before a later filesystem operation
Read a caller-selected path outside the project boundary
Cause HTML，CSS，script，or browser content to be evaluated
Modify a dependency，CI action，build input，or uploaded artifact
Mutate a path whose confinement is not guaranteed

assets.description: Wails App authority to filesystem，process，network，and native APIs
Host files and secrets outside the Karte data root
UI，renderer，ASR，recording，and import availability within runtime budgets
Native process and in-process model/runtime integrity

actors.description: A sender or downloaded page that supplies malicious Markdown，HTML，CSS，CSV，image，audio，or PDF content
A local process that can create symlinks or replace project and selected source paths during an operation
A remote server or DNS responder controlling Web Clip，redirect，asset，or browser subresource responses
A launcher or local user able to alter PATH，binary override variables，ASR config，or model files
A compromised dependency，CI action，build runner，or release publishing step

boundaries.description: JavaScript in the desktop webview crosses into all exported App methods through one Wails binding
Caller-selected native paths or encoded bytes cross into the Karte data root
Project-relative names are resolved to host filesystem paths and persistent artifacts
Remote URLs，DNS answers，redirects，HTML，and assets enter Web Clip processing
Renderer-preserved active HTML is written into a same-origin child browsing context
Raw HTML and local paths cross into an environment-selected browser PDF process
Audio bytes and model paths cross into ffmpeg and native sherpa/ONNX execution
Repository and dependency inputs become archives uploaded and released to users

flows.description: Image，audio，and PDF paths or chunks are bounded，validated，staged，durably published，and served through confined routes
flows.source: OS file dialog path，Base64 payload，or chunk session

flows.description: CSV paths or Base64 are copied，parsed into all records，rendered，and saved through legacy direct filesystem calls
flows.source: OS path，Base64 string，or IPC row matrix

flows.description: A public URL is resolved and fetched，active HTML and unsafe URLs are removed，images are bounded，and Markdown is published
Editor Markdown is rendered with raw HTML，custom CSS is injected，and the result is evaluated in the preview iframe
flows.sink: Same-origin preview iframe with parent Wails authority

flows.description: Content Markdown is scanned and hashed，reopened by Renderer，written to a stage，and atomically published as active HTML
flows.sink: public static site and site index

flows.description: Frontend HTML is augmented with remote scripts，local image paths are embedded，and an external browser receives local-file authority
flows.source: IPC HTML，project images，remote CDN，and environment-selected binary
flows.sink: export PDF，diagnostic log，network，and local filesystem reads

flows.description: Imported audio is passed to an environment or PATH-selected ffmpeg process and bounded PCM is returned
flows.source: Untrusted audio file and process environment
flows.sink: PCM memory，WAV stage，transcription pipeline，and diagnostic log

flows.description: Editable ASR config resolves model paths and native sherpa/ONNX loads them in-process under a runtime budget
Any JavaScript in the bound webview can invoke all exported App methods that resolve，read，write，rename，render，execute，or capture
flows.source: Main frame or same-origin child frame JavaScript
flows.sink: Project and host filesystem，network，processes，screen，and native runtime

flows.description: Pinned source and dependencies are built，compliance files are packaged，archives are smoke-tested，uploaded，and published
flows.source: Repository，Go and npm dependencies，native runtime，CI actions，and runner tools

controls.description: Media source and destination handles are regular，non-symlink，root-confined，identity-pinned，and published without replacement
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must preserve source and destination identity，no-replace，and durability tests

controls.description: Import bytes，sessions，chunks，image dimensions，pixels，and derived image output are bounded before publication
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must retain exact byte，session，heap，and image bomb limits

controls.description: Media routes enforce allowed prefixes and extensions，confined identity，magic bytes，nosniff，and private no-store headers
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must preserve traversal，ancestor symlink，path swap，magic，and header tests

controls.description: CSV requires bounded streaming parse，root-confined identity-pinned I/O，and atomic durable save
controls.closureTask: T-029-B1 replace legacy CSV Stat/Open/ReadAll/O_TRUNC paths with bounded confined handles and deterministic race tests

controls.description: Untrusted renderer output requires active-content sanitization and an opaque sandbox with a narrow message bridge instead of parent DOM and IPC access
controls.closureTask: T-029-B2 define trusted raw HTML policy，sanitize output，move preview integration to a narrow message bridge，and add real-webview injection tests

controls.description: Portable theme discovery rejects active HTML，remote URLs，unsafe CSS，symlinks，and unbounded packages，but runtime consumers do not use its snapshot yet
controls.closureTask: T-029-B3 connect validated theme snapshots to preview，site，and PDF，migrate legacy theme and custom CSS，and enforce CSP

controls.description: Default Web Clip transport disables proxies，validates every DNS address and redirect，then dials a validated public IP directly with byte limits
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must retain public-IP dial pinning，redirect revalidation，proxy disablement，and decoded response limits

controls.description: Web Clip removes active elements，event handlers，unsafe URLs，metadata control syntax，and unsafe assets before Markdown publication
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must preserve bypass-variant sanitizer and unsafe URL tests

controls.description: Site output uses a staged tree，validated manifest，backup recovery，and atomic public/index publication
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must preserve failure rollback，backup recovery，metadata symlink，and cancellation tests

controls.description: Site source bytes and theme assets require one confined，bounded snapshot shared by checksum，render，and publish
controls.closureTask: T-029-B4 replace WalkDir-path reopen with identity-pinned bounded snapshots and publish rewritten validated theme assets

controls.description: PDF rendering requires confined local assets，no ambient network，trusted immutable engine identity，hard input/output limits，and no sensitive logging
controls.closureTask: T-029-B5 remove arbitrary HTML file/network authority，embed validated snapshots，pin the engine，bound resources，and add SSRF/local-file tests

controls.description: ffmpeg PCM output，WAV writes，stderr diagnostics，and cancellation are bounded and checked for short writes
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must preserve PCM，stderr，cancellation，and short-write bounds

controls.description: External decoder and PDF executables require regular non-symlink identity，approved location or signature，version policy，and process isolation
controls.closureTask: T-029-B6 define approved ffmpeg and PDF engine provenance，pin opened identity，and isolate untrusted parser processes with resource limits

controls.description: ASR threads，provider，idle lifetime，single-flight ownership，and shutdown ordering are validated and bounded
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must preserve runtime budget validation，lazy load，lease，and shutdown race tests

controls.description: ASR model and token files require a trusted root or explicit hash policy，identity pinning，size limits，and isolated native load
controls.closureTask: T-029-B7 confine or hash-authorize model files，reject symlink and swap，bound bytes，and load native models in an isolated worker

controls.description: Only the trusted top frame may invoke a minimal capability-scoped IPC allowlist with confined arguments
controls.closureTask: T-029-B8 replace whole-App binding with a reviewed facade，enforce trusted-frame provenance，and test every capability and path boundary

controls.description: Artifact audit validates dependency，license，asset，native metadata，hash，symlink，and untracked-file coverage fail-closed
controls.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must preserve artifact drift，coverage，native symlink，and ancestor-link tests

controls.description: Every final platform tree must pass artifact-audit before archive and upload，then receive immutable checksums，signature，and provenance
controls.closureTask: T-029-B9 invoke artifact-audit on each final tree before archive，pin CI actions，and publish signed checksums and provenance for immutable releases

threats.description: A source，destination，ancestor symlink，or path swap could read outside the selection or overwrite an existing project file
threats.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must keep confined identity and no-replace media tests mandatory
threats.residualRisk: A same-user actor can still deny the operation by racing paths，but accepted bytes remain confined and existing targets are not replaced

threats.description: A valid-signature audio or PDF can exploit or exhaust a downstream native or browser parser
threats.closureTask: T-029-B10 isolate audio and PDF parsers，apply CPU and memory budgets，and add malformed corpus and timeout tests
threats.residualRisk: Audio and PDF publication validates only a short signature before later same-user parser execution，with inputs allowed up to 512 MiB

threats.description: Unbounded CSV input and lexical joined paths permit memory exhaustion，symlink reads，TOCTOU overwrite，and root escape through IPC
threats.closureTask: T-029-B1 implement bounded streaming CSV with confined identity-pinned source/read/save and atomic durable no-replace publication
threats.residualRisk: ImportCsvFile uses Stat then Open，ReadAll and Base64 are unbounded，and GetCsvFile or SaveCsvFile directly join caller paths and follow links

threats.description: Renderer-preserved script or event HTML executes in an unsandboxed same-origin iframe and can invoke the parent Wails App authority
threats.closureTask: T-029-B2 sanitize untrusted renderer output，use an opaque sandbox and narrow message bridge，and prove App IPC is unreachable from injected preview content
threats.residualRisk: The iframe has no sandbox or CSP，document.write evaluates active HTML，and current parent integrations require direct contentDocument access

threats.description: Legacy layout or custom CSS can inject active markup，load remote resources，exfiltrate data，or vary preview，site，and PDF output
threats.closureTask: T-029-B3 migrate legacy layouts and custom CSS to validated snapshots，reject markup breakouts and remote URLs，and enforce CSP across outputs
threats.residualRisk: Portable discovery is not connected to runtime，legacy templates use CDN scripts，custom CSS is raw string-injected，and Mermaid loose HTML labels remain enabled

threats.description: A crafted URL，DNS answer，or redirect attempts to make Web Clip access a private，loopback，link-local，or metadata service
threats.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must retain DNS-address validation，direct validated-IP dialing，proxy disablement，and redirect tests
threats.residualRisk: Production uses the pinned default transport，while a future custom Service.Client must preserve the same dial-time IP validation contract

threats.description: Remote active HTML，unsafe URLs，metadata syntax，or oversized responses attempt stored script execution or resource exhaustion during clipping
threats.closureTask: T-029 regression gate must keep sanitizer bypass，oversized response，path，symlink，and no-replace fixtures mandatory
threats.residualRisk: Sanitized clipped Markdown can later be manually edited into unsafe raw HTML，which is tracked separately at the preview boundary

threats.description: A source file swap after WalkDir or checksum can make site rendering reopen a symlink or different inode outside the project root
threats.closureTask: T-029-B4 render from the same bounded confined byte snapshot used for hashing and add deterministic file and ancestor swap tests
threats.residualRisk: Directory，public，and metadata links are rejected，but source regular-file identity is not pinned across scan，ReadFile，checksum，and Renderer reopen

threats.description: Raw HTML，legacy theme scripts，or remote theme assets are published into the static site without a declared trust or network policy
threats.owner: Renderer theme integration and site builder
threats.closureTask: T-029-B3 define trusted site HTML policy，sanitize when untrusted，and copy or rewrite only validated deterministic theme snapshots
threats.residualRisk: The site faithfully emits active raw HTML and does not package validated theme assets，so visitors execute document and theme content under the deployed origin

threats.description: Raw PDF HTML or a traversal and symlink image source can read host files when the browser engine receives local-file access
threats.closureTask: T-029-B5 accept only validated asset handles or snapshots，remove ambient local-file access，and add traversal，symlink，file URL，and swap tests
threats.residualRisk: Image conversion joins untrusted data/image paths and follows links，arbitrary HTML remains，and Renderer is called with AllowLocalFiles true

threats.description: PDF HTML and helper injection can request arbitrary network resources，leak document context，or change output through mutable CDN code
threats.closureTask: T-029-B5 disable browser network，bundle exact Mermaid and KaTeX assets，apply CSP，and test remote URL and redirect rejection
threats.residualRisk: PDF helper injection uses jsDelivr including katex latest，and arbitrary remote script，style，image，and font URLs remain available to the browser

threats.description: Environment or PATH substitution selects an unintended ffmpeg or PDF executable，or a malicious document exploits an unsandboxed parser process
threats.closureTask: T-029-B6 approve and verify executable identity，reject symlinks and swaps，record version provenance，and sandbox parser CPU，memory，filesystem，and network
threats.residualRisk: FFMPEG_PATH，KARTE_PDF_BINARY，PATH，and common locations are trusted without hash，signature，opened identity，or process sandbox

threats.description: A corrupt，oversized，symlinked，swapped，or outside-root ONNX model is loaded into the application process without runtime provenance verification
threats.closureTask: T-029-B7 enforce trusted-root or hash authorization，identity and byte limits，and isolated worker loading for every token and model file
threats.residualRisk: Editable config accepts absolute paths，model checks use Stat，and compliance hashes bundled assets only at build or artifact audit time

threats.description: Whole-App IPC binding and lexical path checks let injected JavaScript invoke sensitive methods or follow project links into host paths
threats.closureTask: T-029-B8 bind a minimal capability facade，authenticate the top frame，and migrate every listed path API to confined handle and identity semantics
threats.residualRisk: All exported App methods are bound without caller provenance，and general Markdown，board，metadata，CSV，theme，rename，and export paths do not share the media confinement primitive

threats.description: A final platform tree can be archived and uploaded without invoking the existing fail-closed artifact coverage audit
threats.closureTask: T-029-B9 run artifact-audit for every final platform tree after native packaging and before archive，smoke，upload，and release
threats.residualRisk: CI verifies repository compliance fixtures and startup behavior，but does not audit the actual final tree for dependency，license，native，asset，and untracked-file drift

threats.description: Mutable CI action references，unsigned archives，movable release tags，and runtime-selected binaries weaken provenance and rollback attribution
threats.closureTask: T-029-B9 pin actions by commit，publish immutable versioned releases with signed checksums and provenance，and document runtime binary trust policy
threats.residualRisk: Major action tags and a force-moved rolling tag remain，macOS uses ad-hoc signing，and no cross-platform signature，notarization，checksum，or provenance attestation is published
